text.text_excerpt: I was fortunate enough to connect with mamita's original New Orleans Hot Tamales yesterday. I called the number 504-813- 6195, left a mesg and the owner Bernie called back the same day. His schedule had to change because of the freeze, but I waited with anticipation to get my tamales as he described. I can remember El Ranchito's on Elysian Fields when my brother was home from the war, would bring them to my mama. Mamita's should be an icon worn just like K&B and the lot. I placed a big order ahead of time, and it was ready when I got there, coming hot out of the pot. It was a pleasure meeting the young and handsome owner/Chef Bernie. Bernie had the great old school manners and the energy ...

Found this place through Facebook one day and decided to give them a try. While trying to decide on what to order, the owner was kind enough to let me try one of the beef tamales. Immediately after trying a bite, I decided to buy a dozen of them. He suggested switching out one beef tamale out for a corn tamale to try out. I brought the tamales to a friend's house and shared them with my friends. The tamales were so fresh and it felt like I was eating juicy homemade tamales. The corn tamale really surprised me, it was seasoned really well and I may have liked it more than the beef tamale. It is something that I wouldn't have thought to order, but it is definitely pretty good. I visited him...

I love the beef tamales. I love the corn tamales. I love Mamita's hot tamales. It really is that simple. The beef are spicy! But I love spicy... Check facebook for locations and times. They move around alot and will deliver if you are in the area. This is not a full -size food truck, so dont make the mistake of looking for one. Keep an eye out for a guy in a truck with a tamale box on the hitch. They are usually in bank parking lots and if it rains they will be under the drive through canopy. They also sell them frozen and these make a great lunch at work!
